snippet.title: Rally Point – Official Trailer | Strategy Roguelite (Early Access Nov 24)
snippet.description:
A strategy roguelite set in a galaxy that fights back. Build a squad of 3 Heroes, 3 Mechs and 4 Support Cards from 90+ options, push the lanes, and take on enemy factions that reinforce, counterattack and contest your ground. Solo or co-op, with online 1v1, 2v2 and free-for-all.

If you like Clash Royale or Warcraft Rumble lane battles, the run-to-run build crafting of 9 Kings, or the real-time card-style strategy of Minion Masters, Rally Point is built for you.

Free demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5084600/Rally_Point_Demo/
Wishlist (Early Access 24 November 2026): https://store.steampowered.com/app/5046790/Rally_Point/
Website: https://rallypointgame.com/
Discord: https://discord.gg/Vu5vjXuBEd
More games by AnotherBuild: https://anotherbuild.com/
